summary: Bug reproduced on live: CoWoS wafer demand vs capacity gap LineChart renders 4 data points (two at year 2026) because deployed bundle uses metric.includes('CoWoS wafer demand'), pulling cowos-demand-2026 (~1000K) and google-cowos-2026 (~240K). Local build with frontend fix (id.startsWith('cowos-demand-')) renders 3 points with one 2026 tick.
